result.Method of Attack: Rootkit malware that hijacks inbound TCP network traffic via a Netfilter hook in the Linux kernel, establishes persistence by modifying startup scripts, and launches a disguised user-space process to execute attacker commands remotely with root privileges; executes a shell script to deploy malicious kernel module and user-space binary; uses specially crafted attack-init TCP packets to authenticate attacker and establish encrypted communication channel; creates procfs entries for communication between kernel module and user-space process; user-space process disguises as 'bash', forks a child process replaced by /bin/sh to execute commands; supports control commands to restart, kill, or send signals to child and parent processes
result.Attack Vector: Remote exploitation of multiple vulnerabilities in Ivanti appliance to deploy rootkit and user-space malware; remote TCP network traffic hijacking via Netfilter hook; persistence via /etc/rc.local and /etc/rc.d/rc.local modifications
Indicators of Compromise: Modification of /etc/rc.local and /etc/rc.d/rc.local to load rootkit on startup
Network traffic containing specially crafted 0xd byte attack-init TCP packets
